title: HTTPRouter
description: An HTTP router that matches incoming requests and routes them to services.

name.description: The name of the router in name@provider format.

entryPoints.description: Entry points this router is bound to.

middlewares.description: Middlewares applied to this router in order.

service.description: The service this router routes traffic to.

rule.description: The routing rule expression (e.g., Host, Path, Headers matchers).

ruleSyntax.description: The syntax version of the rule.

priority.description: The priority of the router when multiple routers match.

status.description: The current status of the router.

using.description: Entry points being used by this router.

provider.description: The configuration provider that created this router.
